name: com.nexengineworks.nexui
description:
Backend-independent runtime UI framework for Unity. Provides Screen, Layer, State, Binding, Command, Motion, Theme, Query, Debug, Settings, Validation, and optional backend integrations.

REQUIRED BEFORE IMPORT: UniTask 2.5.10 or newer (com.cysharp.unitask). NexUI's core assembly references it directly and will not compile without it. UniTask is not on the Unity registry - install it from https://github.com/Cysharp/UniTask via Package Manager > Add package from git URL, or through OpenUPM.

samples.description: Basic NexUI runtime sample with screen, state, binding, and motion.
Runtime UI Toolkit sample with HUD, bindings, motion, and theme switching.
Runtime uGUI sample with HUD, pause menu, button actions, value binding, and theme tokens.
Reference sample for optional DOTween, VContainer, MessagePipe, Addressables, and Input System integrations.
Motion sample covering popup, toast, gesture feedback, layout motion, and shared element transition concepts.
Theme sample covering light/dark themes, runtime token overrides, responsive rules, and theme transitions.
Minimal Motion Clip Editor sample: scale+alpha panel-open animation played via UIManager.PlayMotionClipAsync.
CollectionView sample: 10,000 virtualized rows, selection, scroll-to, and the loading/empty/error states on both backends.
